ctx.x: In the Catskills, yeah, and at the Club Neverly, Kenny Davenport, to be positive, exact, his -- part of his -- some parts of his family, I think his mother, worked there, and secretary to this main man, the big boss, and he knew about this job, and asked me if I wanted it, and sent me up to take it.
So when I got in touch, and they -- everything went fine. So the man told me, this manager, told me, McClosky's manager, I never talked to him then --
